statement: On every open loop-generated orbit outside X_star with at most two actual boundary-quotient partitions, the intrinsic contractions can be chosen with exponential target fractions on metabelian intrinsic target images and the natural median on the other target images. For a compact proper-operator quotient, this contraction extends continuously, with continuous inverse, to the whole orbit closure. These extensions agree exactly with the prescribed C50 contraction on X_star and on common frontiers, and paste with X_star over any finite collection.
depends_on: C27-C29 natural median and based circle lifts; C32-C33 exact intrinsic centralizer contraction; C37 actual transitive metabelian line/circle images; C42 evaluation quotient and compact-open topology; C45-C46 full two-partition coordinates and operator transport; C48 exact one-partition operator forms; C50 exponential contraction on X_star; C51 compact fundamental set and actual-operator frontier approximation; diagonal interior approximation for frontier-only sequences
manuscript_passages: Section 23, folios 140-141, scans 279-281; Part C(b) infinite-operator request; relative frontier extension preserving the already prescribed exponential region
depends_on_doubtful_reading: None. The target case selection is made in the actual intrinsic group generated by the original target loop. Its real lifts and all source/target covering maps are retained. The proof does not assume that the mixed target prescription is continuous on the entire nonopen locus.
notes: Exponential fractions lie in the actual translation or positive affine target group, commute with every target operator centralizing the original loop, and are natural under all target reparametrizations and the two-coordinate exchange. They can therefore replace the median base maps in the proved C46/C48 formulas without changing their operator equations. A circle uses its based real path even when an intermediate projected endpoint is the identity with a nonzero integer angle. C51's compact-fundamental-set argument proves every interior-to-frontier limit using the modified exact quotient equations. A diagonal interior approximation then proves joint continuity for arbitrary frontier-only sequences, including switches between the metabelian and nonmetabelian branches; the same argument treats inverses. Every nonopen image on X_star is metabelian because the second-derived identity extends from its dense open Lie union. Thus the new boundary fraction is exactly C50's fraction. Finite closed-set pasting gives the stated relative extension. Continuity on the rest of the nonopen locus, infinitely varying closures, and noncocompact quotients remains unproved; C12 remains Open.
computational_checks: Pure topological argument; no new finite computation is used.
